title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 038
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute link and unlink variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Two chain loops joined diagonally with open curved ends facing inward
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a linked chain shown on a diagonal without extra breaks or sparks.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the parallel or looped links when the diagonal join is the key cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows two linked chain ends meeting diagonally across the center.

items.depicts_observation: Two chain loops joined on a diagonal with straighter inner connector bars
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the diagonal chain link variant with straighter inner bar segments.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the more curved diagonal chain when the inner straight bars matter.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot tightens the inner connector shapes into straighter bar segments.

items.depicts_observation: Two rounded chain loops interlocked horizontally with a centered join
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a horizontal interlocked chain rather than a diagonal one.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the diagonal link variants when the loops should sit side by side.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot turns the chain into two horizontal loops interlocked at the center.

items.depicts_observation: Broken diagonal chain loops with four short spark marks around the split
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a broken chain icon with spark marks around the separation.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for intact links when the break and surrounding spark marks matter.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot breaks the diagonal chain and adds four short spark marks around the gap.

items.depicts_observation: Broken diagonal chain loops with separated halves and spark marks above and below
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the broken chain variant whose two halves pull farther apart.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the tighter broken link when the wider split between halves should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot opens the gap between the chain halves wider than the first unlink variant.
